title: Northstar Security Exits Stealth With $7M to Expose Toxic Risk Combinations
description: Northstar Security is a startup that has emerged from stealth mode with $7 million in seed funding to develop AI-driven security solutions. The company builds a real-time Security Context Graph that maps identities, assets, applications, vulnerabilities, and business systems to identify risky combinations of security issues. Its platform helps security teams detect and remediate complex risk scenarios that may not be evident when issues are considered individually. The solution integrates with over 70 enterprise security and IT products and allows analysts to interact with findings using natural language queries. Northstar’s AI agents can initiate remediation actions under supervision. The startup aims to improve security context and reduce risk exposure for organizations.
